parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle or lever part of the switch made of ABS plastic, typically small and protruding from the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for turning the electrical circuit on or off by toggling up or down.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or pivots around a small axis to change the electrical contact state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing or mounting plate of the switch, made of polycarbonate, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal electrical components and provides a surface for mounting the switch to a wall or panel.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
